summary: Create visual reference: Chapter opener example
instructions:
Approved example of how every chapter opener looks.

Read style/visual-bible.md first and follow it exactly.
No text of any kind inside the artwork - typography is set by the deterministic renderer, never generated.
Save the result as a draft, then submit it.

Fixed at intake - do not change without the operator:
- Title: exactly "The Padel Addict's Guide to Talking About Anything Else"
- Main character: Josh, 31, a management consultant, married to Lauren, two children under five (Mia, 4, and Alfie, 1). Fixed look: short beard, a smartwatch he never takes off, and a padel brand cap or quarter-zip whether he is at the office or a toddler's birthday party.
- Print colour: black and white
- Cover style: big lettering (a text-only cover, bold type, no picture)
